_comment: Copy to mcp_servers.json (same folder, git-ignored) to give the agent tools from external MCP servers. Keys starting with '_' are ignored; "enabled": false switches a server off; ${VAR} is read from the environment (backend/.env), so keep tokens there. Shape: langchain-mcp-adapters MultiServerMCPClient. Tools that change something (send/create/delete/...) run only when the user's own message asks for an action.
